record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The five units in appliesTo declare SLUDGE_WAVE in this production reference. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index), range, maxPP and passive. Passive HATCH (Tympole, Palpitoad) is not investigated.
record.summary: For every enemy in the 3x3 block centred on the cast target (centre included), applies one poison stack with a star-indexed duration (AP- and crit-scaled), then deals a flat star-indexed amount of special damage. Poison then ticks for 5% of the target's max HP per stack per second as true damage (status code, bounded read).

targeting.who: the cast target passed to process is the centre; every cell of the 3x3 around it (centre included, off-board cells dropped) that holds a unit of the other team is hit. Allies are skipped.
targeting.note: Target selection before the cast and the range check were not read. The enemy check is 'team != caster team' on the cell's unit.

geometry.shape: 3x3 block centred on the target, centre included

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: then the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later untraced modifiers; blocked per target by protect / skydiving / magicBounce

statusEffects.scaling: duration x (1 + caster AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit), rounded, written into the strategy; stack count is not scaled
statusEffects.applicationOrder: poison is applied BEFORE the damage call for each enemy, in cell scan order (row by row)
statusEffects.guards: not applied if IMMUNITY_POISON or runeProtect; duration then passes through applyStatusDurationReductions (not read); a new duration replaces the remaining time only if longer
statusEffects.stacking: +1 stack per application, capped at 3 (4 if the caster has VENOMOUS, 5 if TOXIC); stacks and origin reset when the poison cooldown ends
statusEffects.combatEffect: each tick (1000 ms) deals 5% of the target's max HP per stack as TRUE damage, reduced by rain, assault vest, toxic boost, swift swim / hydration / water veil / surge surfer factors; Gliscor's passive reduces effective stacks by 2

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star column (80 damage, 8000 ms) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the five units (2,2,3,1,1). Whether other mechanics raise a star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Needs a target; the area is the 3x3 block centred on it, so edge targets cover fewer cells. Only enemy-team units in those cells are affected.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state and no modes in the strategy; repeated casts add a stack each time (up to the cap) and extend the poison only if the new duration is longer.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 10/20/40 and poison 2000/3000/4000 ms (1-3 stars). Damage dealt is raw x (1 + AP/100), then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers. The poison length is the raw duration x (1 + AP/100) (x critPower on crit) after the listed status modifiers; its damage over time comes from the status tick, not the strategy.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
